snippet.title: Wildcard – Official Trailer (Early Access October 21)
snippet.description:
Wildcard is a new free to play fusion of arena combat and strategic deck building. We've built a game that fuses concepts from MOBAs, Hero Shooters, and TCGs. Choose your champion, summon creatures, and outplay rivals in fast, dynamic arena battles! Coming soon to Steam ↓

🎮 Play free during Steam Next Fest (Oct 13–20)
🚀 Early Access begins October 21

👉 Wishlist now on Steam: http://play.wildcardgame.com/steam


CHOOSE YOUR CHAMPION
Fierce tacticians, burly brawlers, agile tricksters - each Champion brings unique abilities to the arena, and you’re calling the shots. Of course, victory is never earned alone. Champions fight side-by-side with their teammate, forging dynamic 2v2 strategies where teamwork is everything. The right Champion doesn’t just shape your deck -  they define your legend.


SUMMON YOUR STRONGEST
Unleash your powerful pack of summons into the arena and watch them blaze a path to Wildcard glory. It could be a tank holding the line, a sniper striking from range, a blitzer charging in, or a shielder protecting you at the critical moment. Some arrive with explosive impact, others linger to control the fight, but anyone can shift momentum in an instant. Summons are your frontline army, your tactical weapons, and the link between your Champion’s abilities and your team’s victory. The way you build and deploy your deck determines the flow of battle itself.


COMPETE IN EPIC ARENAS
Dive into adrenaline-fueled 2v2 battles fusing high-impact action gameplay with strategic deck-building. Each match is a contest of skill and coordination where control of the fight can change in a heartbeat. Champions clash across diverse arena layouts, demanding adaptability and rewarding smart positioning, quick reactions, and team coordination. With tight third-person combat, real-time decision-making, and dynamic tactical options, every showdown is a competitive spectacle that rewards mastery, creativity, and bold plays.


ASSEMBLE YOUR DECK
Every card in your deck is a piece of your strategy - from resilient frontline summons to disruptive tricksters, game-changing Wildcards, and powerful Champion talents. Building the perfect deck means balancing aggression, control, and combo potential while tailoring your playstyle to every situation. Study your summons up close, explore their stats and abilities, and with each new deck build, you can stay one step ahead of your rivals.


BE PART OF THE ACTION
Take your rightful place in the Arena and prove you’re the ultimate Champion. Master unique playstyles, summon powerful allies, outthink your opponents with tactical deckbuilding, and dominate the battlefield in adrenaline-fueled 2v2 combat. The path to Wildcard victory is yours to claim - are you ready to take it?
